lines: A dim garage or a sunny room: pick the theme that reads best.
Wattzup opens dark, even on a device that prefers light. Volt numbers on ink, easy on tired eyes.
The sun in the app bar is the Light theme button. Tap it.
The whole dashboard turns light, at once, with no reload.
The power trace redraws in the new colours.
Your choice sticks: after a reload, and on every screen, like Set up your ride.
On a phone, dark or light, the same numbers lead.
What the tests prove: the app is dark by default, even when the device prefers light.
And the theme you pick is kept after a reload, on every screen.
That is journey thirteen. Wattzup turns an Echelon bike into a live training display.
